meta.project: OXOT hyperscale AI datacenter — representative reference model
meta.generated_from: campus-model.js (three.js build) — mesh names are authoritative and match the exported GLB

scales.facility: facility-graph.json — site-wide systems: substation, MV/LV, UPS, generators, BESS, chiller plant, towers, MMR, NOC, OT boundary, fire, security
scales.hall: hall-graph.json — data hall: 6 rows x (16 GPU racks + row CDU + end-of-row network rack) and every per-rack connection
scales.rack: rack-graph.json — internals of one 48U liquid-cooled GPU rack, applied as a template to all 96 rack instances

conventions.mesh: every asset carries `mesh`, the exact node name in the GLB; children share the prefix
conventions.edge: connections are directed from -> to; `service` is what flows, `protocol` is how it is carried, `physical_run` is the routed geometry that realises it

assets.label: Utility grid intake
attack_surface: Utility interface is outside the operator security perimeter — treat as untrusted source.

assets.label: GIS switchgear
attack_surface: Protection IEDs report to Z2 via IEC 61850 MMS — one documented conduit.

assets.label: Pad-mount transformer
attack_surface: Winding temperature monitor and Buchholz relay are Z3 field instruments.

assets.label: MV switchgear ZX2
attack_surface: Relay IEDs form a Z3 sub-zone; station bus interface to Z2 must be explicitly documented.

assets.label: Protection relay SEL-751A
attack_surface: GOOSE on the process bus is unauthenticated by default — segment and disable unused ports.
Engineering access (DIGSI/AcSELerator class tooling) must route through the Z5 jump host.

assets.label: LV switchgear
attack_surface: Firmware-capable "smart" breakers are elevated OT attack surface — dedicated VLAN required.

assets.label: ATS (Magnum)
attack_surface: Ethernet-capable transfer controllers require a dedicated management VLAN.

assets.label: UPS 9395XR
attack_surface: Network management card exposes SNMP, Modbus TCP and a web UI — isolate in a UPS management VLAN.
Microsoft OCP mandate applies directly to UPS network cards.
Vendor cloud service portal is a Z2 → external conduit and must transit the Z1 DMZ.

assets.label: EPMS meter ION9000

attributes.protocols: OPC UA, DNP3, IEC 61850, Modbus TCP

attack_surface: EPMS SCADA must be segmented from IT by firewall or unidirectional gateway.
Each supported protocol is a separate conduit requiring its own documentation.

assets.label: Battery string 1
attack_surface: Battery monitoring head-end (Albér / BTECH class) is a Z2 asset; sensing units are Z3.
Uptime and NERC CIP auditors require 2-year data retention.

assets.label: RPP 1 (with BCMS)
attack_surface: Metered RPPs sit on the Z3/Z2 boundary — BCMS aggregation is Z2, DCIM dashboard is Z1.

assets.label: Generator CAT 3516C
attack_surface: Engine ECM/ECU is Z3; SAE J1939 gateways need explicit zone assignment.

assets.label: Generator paralleling control
attack_surface: Highest-value Z2 electrical target — holds authority over generation dispatch.
Supports Modbus TCP, IEC 60870-5-101/104 and SNMP; each is a separate conduit.

assets.label: BESS Megapack
attack_surface: PCS/inverter speaking DNP3 or IEC 61850 is a high-risk conduit endpoint.
Li-ion deployment mandates off-gas detection.

assets.label: BESS controller / microgrid
assets.standards: IEEE 2030.7, NERC CIP (if above BES threshold)
attack_surface: Microgrid controller holds authority over all on-site generation — highest-value Z2 asset.
Grid-operator interface (IEEE 2030.7 / DNP3) is a priority Z2 → external conduit.

assets.label: Hall busway spine
attack_surface: Critical Power Monitor over Modbus TCP is a Z3 → Z2 conduit.

assets.label: Rack 01 power shelf
attack_surface: Shelf controller firmware is an OCP S.A.F.E. scope item.
A malicious PSU firmware image produces correlated failure across every row.

assets.label: Cooling tower BAC 3000
attack_surface: Chemical dosing wireless links are conduits — isolate and document.
Legionella water management plan legally required (ASHRAE 188).

assets.label: Chiller 30XW
attack_surface: OEM cloud diagnostics is a Z2 → external conduit and must transit the Z1 DMZ.
Plant compromise causes thermal shutdown of the IT load — treat as safety-adjacent.

assets.label: Chiller plant controller
attack_surface: Holds setpoint authority over the whole thermal chain.

assets.label: Pump VFD ACQ580
attack_surface: Drives with Modbus RTU/TCP or PROFINET carry direct control authority over flow.

assets.label: Water treatment PLC
attack_surface: Target for firmware security validation to reach SL-3/4.
TCS loop resistivity >1 MΩ·cm required for bare-copper direct-to-chip cooling.

assets.label: Row 01 CDU
assets.standards: OCP Liquid Cooling Spec, ASHRAE TC 9.9
attack_surface: CDU vendor cloud portal is a Z2 → external conduit.
Manipulating flow or temperature setpoints causes thermal runaway in ~90 s at full load.
Firmware checks on CDUs are a high-value assurance target for AI halls.

assets.label: Row 01 CDU controller
attack_surface: Direct cyber-physical authority over pumps and valves for a 130 kW+ row.

assets.label: Rack 01 compute tray
assets.standards: OCP S.A.F.E., IEC 62443-4-1, TCG TPM 2.0, Caliptra
attack_surface: BMC (OpenBMC class) is an embedded control plane with its own network path.
BIOS/firmware and DPU/SmartNIC images are ICS supply-chain scope under IEC 62443-2-4.
TPM / root-of-trust (Caliptra) anchors measured boot.

assets.label: Rack 01 management tray
attack_surface: Out-of-band management plane — must sit on an isolated OOB VLAN reachable only via the jump host.

assets.label: Row 01 leak detection
attack_surface: Liquid cooling requires detection at every CDU, manifold and quick-disconnect.

assets.label: CRAH 1
attack_surface: Vendor remote service portal (iCOM / SiteController class) is a Z2 → external conduit.

assets.label: CRAH 1 controller
attack_surface: Receives the fire-alarm HVAC shutdown interlock — verify it cannot be defeated from the network.

assets.label: Battery room H2 exhaust
attack_surface: Ventilation start is a safety function — interlocked at the starter, not operator-overridable.

assets.label: Battery room H2 detector
attack_surface: Off-gas detection is mandatory wherever Li-ion UPS or BESS is deployed.

assets.label: Fire alarm panel
attack_surface: Z4 must be isolated from all other zones; supervisory output to Z2 is one-way only.
Panel → central station is a Z4 → external conduit (listed supervising station).

assets.label: Row 01 VESDA sampling pipe
attack_surface: Detector → FACP is a supervised Z3 → Z4 conduit.

assets.label: EPO station
attack_surface: Hard-wired safety circuit — must not be reachable from any network.

attributes.diversity: physically separate path from entry B

assets.label: Perimeter firewall A
attack_surface: Network boundary protection: the enterprise-side control on every IT ↔ OT crossing.

assets.label: DMZ switch
attack_surface: IDMZ is the most security-critical architectural element in the facility.

assets.label: Row 01 OOB console
attack_surface: Out-of-band path bypasses in-band controls — SL-T 3 and jump-host-only access.

assets.label: Jump host / PAM A
attack_surface: Sole sanctioned path for vendor and engineering access into Z2/Z3 — SL-T 3.

assets.label: Ceiling access point 1
attack_surface: Wireless in the white space is an additional radio attack surface — 802.1X and rogue-AP monitoring.

assets.label: OT switch TN-4900
attack_surface: High priority for firmware code review (whitebox).

assets.label: OT firewall EDR-9010
attack_surface: Enforces the Z2 → Z1 conduit; deny-by-default with per-protocol allow lists.

assets.label: Data diode
attack_surface: Hardware-enforced one-way path; the only sanctioned Z2 → Z1 data export.

assets.label: Protocol gateway L-Gate

attributes.translates: BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU, LON, 4-20 mA → BACnet/IP

attack_surface: Protocol translation collapses many field conduits into one — a single high-value target.

assets.label: BMS head-end (EBI)
attack_surface: Vendor remote access to the BMS is an explicitly documented Z2 → external conduit.

assets.label: DCIM (Environet)
attack_surface: Historian must be read-only toward Z2 — it must never push commands downward.
DCIM cloud connectivity is a Z1 → external conduit.

assets.label: OT IDS (Nozomi)
attack_surface: Passive only — no active scanning of live process networks.

assets.label: Operator workstation
attack_surface: Engineering workstations are the classic pivot into Z2 — application allow-listing and no direct internet.

assets.label: Access control head end
attack_surface: Physical access control is a cyber-physical system — compromise holds doors and defeats zone boundaries.

assets.label: Mantrap card reader
attack_surface: Legacy MIFARE Classic credentials are cryptographically broken — migrate to DESFire EV3.
Use OSDP secure channel; Wiegand is clear-text and cloneable.

assets.label: Biometric reader
attack_surface: Biometric templates are special-category personal data under GDPR.

assets.label: Perimeter camera 1
attack_surface: Camera firmware is a recurring gap — component gap analysis required.
IP cameras are a common initial-access foothold; isolate on a dedicated VLAN.
